exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Noun + chuu (in the middle of ~)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
名詞＋中（ちゅう）
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞＋中（ちゅう） matches "Noun + chuu (in the middle of ~)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞＋中（ちゅう）.
exercises.explanation: Used after nouns to show something is currently happening or ongoing.
